title: A white truck with a blue and lime W
label: Brand gallery
lede: Webvan’s brand lived on its trucks: a white box with a big blue and lime W and the wordmark running up the side. What survives of it is in archived pages; the van, the totes and the warehouse are our own drawings.

recreation.title: The look, rebuilt
recreation.headline: Free delivery over $50
recreation.body: Text paraphrased from archived 1999–2000 pages. The layout is our recreation, not a copy of the original site.

disclaimer: Colors were sampled from pixels in the archived Nov 2000 page and are approximate because of image compression. Logos appear here in historical and editorial context; Webvan and its marks belong to their owners. Drawings are original recreations.
